en: Black-and-white street view showing a historic town gate tower with a clock at the center of a busy street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. In the foreground there is a fountain with a basin and a column topped by a statue of a man working with or pushing a wheel (Radmacherbrunnen). Vintage cars and pedestrians are visible. Text at the bottom identifies the scene as Rietstraße with Radmacherbrunnen in Villingen in the Black Forest.
